title: 778. K-th Symbol in Grammar

examples.explanation: The opening row is a single 0.

hints: Each position inherits from its parent at index (k+1)/2 in the previous row; an even k flips the parent value.
Equivalently the answer equals the parity of the number of ones in the binary form of k-1.
Recursion or a simple loop over the bits both run in O(n) time.
